passives.name: ZerefEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
This unit has $ZerefBlackMagic meter, starting at 0.
- When $ZerefBlackMagic Meter is increasing this unit will be in "Caring State"
- When $ZerefBlackMagic Meter is decreasing this unit will be in "Cold state"
Caring state:
- Every {1} seconds this unit walks increases this meter by {2}
- Deal {3}% of this unit's current damage in {4}% of his range
Cold State:
- Every {5} seconds this unit walks decrease this meter by {6}
- Deal {7}% of this unit's current damage in {8}% of his range
